plugins.name: clean-code
plugins.description: Teaches the agent to write readable, understandable, maintainable code: intent-revealing naming, small single-purpose functions, guard clauses over nesting, minimal comments, pragmatic DRY, SOLID design, code smells, and clean tests.

plugins.name: git-haiku
plugins.description: Lightweight git automation on Haiku: inspect status and diff, draft a concise Conventional Commits message, commit, and push to the current remote branch — no unnecessary commentary.

plugins.name: project-blueprint
plugins.description: Plans a software project end to end before any code is written, then captures the result as durable context files (AGENTS.md + context/) that keep agents accurate across sessions: a decision log that keeps its reasoning, phased specs with mechanically checkable exit criteria, an explicit scope boundary, UI tokens/rules/registry, and verification rules that stop invented versions and APIs.
